# apple_alternative_distribution_key (Data Source)

Reads the alternative distribution key of an app. The key's ID is part of install verification tokens.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_alternative_distribution_key" "example" {
  app_id = data.apple_app.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the key.
- `public_key` (String) The public key.
